fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property at night or under poor visibility conditions.
• Trim trees and shrubs along the driveway so emergency vehicles can travel the full length without obstruction.
• Keep the driveway clear of parked vehicles to allow full emergency vehicle access to the residence.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the walkway to keep a clear path from the driveway to the front door.
• Mark any gate or opening in the perimeter fencing that provides access to the rear of the property with a visible sign or reflective marker.
• Keep any rear gate unlocked or equipped with a breakaway latch so responders can reach the rear of the property without delay.
• Thin dense vegetation between the main residence and the detached structure so responders can move between the two buildings.
• Keep the patio area clear of furniture, equipment, or stored materials that could block movement around the rear of the residence.
• Identify a flat, open area near the driveway where a second emergency vehicle can stage without blocking the primary access point.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim branches from the tree cluster that extend close to or over any part of the structure.
• Thin shrubs growing directly next to the structure to create open space between the plants and the walls.
• Remove or cut back ground vegetation growing up against the base of the structure.
• Trim overhanging branches along the driveway to keep the travel path clear for vehicles.
• Cut back shrubs along the driveway edge that narrow the passable width or reduce visibility.
• Thin scattered shrubs near the structure so individual plants are separated from each other and from the building.
• Remove low-hanging branches from large trees near the structure to reduce the connection between ground plants and the tree canopy.
• Keep the open green space areas mowed or cut short to reduce ground-level plant material near the structure.
• Separate any scattered trees near the structure by removing the shrubs and ground vegetation growing between them and the building.
